description: This Java source file defines a final class ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetter, which extends AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter with a focus on setting acknowledgment requests for ThingCommand objects, specifically for live response acknowledgments in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides a singleton instance and overrides methods to determine applicability and class matching for commands.

classes.name: ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetter
classes.description: A singleton class extending AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter to set acknowledgment requests for ThingCommand objects, specifically for live response acknowledgments.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetter.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines whether the given ThingCommand is applicable for extending headers with acknowledgment requests, based on whether it is a live channel command.

methods.name: getMatchedClass
methods.description: Returns the Class object corresponding to ThingCommand, used for matching command types.

methods.name: isBindResponseRequiredToAddingRemovingImplicitLabel
methods.description: Indicates whether binding responses are required when adding or removing implicit labels, returns true.
